sources.title: Get messages by conversation id | HighLevel API

contracts: Conversation search lastMessageType is a projection, not an occurrence identity or an unread/inbound channel guess.
Get messages example uses messageType SMS with numeric type, locationId, conversationId, id, dateAdded, direction and attachments.
Message identity is provider/location/message. Distinct messages with the same body remain distinct.
A completed/inbound/missed call does not establish voicemail. Unknown types are not guessed.
Native voicemail/media fixtures and live native qualification remain separate from this documentation receipt.
